status: Local validation draft: combined source/outside RMSE, power and signed Fourier correlation

settings.layout: one row, three columns; no panel titles or footer notes

source_mask.rule: Smooth the full signed JWST reference with a normalized Gaussian; estimate median and sigma-clipped standard deviation from valid smoothed pixels at radius 70–95. Detect all 8-connected regions with at least 10 pixels above median + threshold*sigma; fill holes and dilate by a radius-3 disk. Intersect with common validity and crop to the central 105x105 pixels only after detection. Background is the complement within common validity. No per-model masks.

settings.source_window: Strict support: fixed 2-sigma JWST source mask intersected with common validity, including all detected neighbours. Exactly zero outside this support. Inward sine-squared distance taper width=3 target pixels times separable Tukey alpha=0.5; subtract each image own weighted mean before FFT; FFT divided by sqrt(sum(window**2)). Same window for every model and JWST.
settings.outside_window: Outside the fixed 2-sigma source mask, with a 3-pixel cosine taper to source/invalid boundaries and the outer Tukey window. Window-energy normalized. Usable if sum(w**2)>16 and effective area sum(w)**2/sum(w**2)>=64. An empirical background proxy, not an unbiased noise PSD; contains faint sources and mask coupling.
settings.power: Geometric mean over objects of P_model/P_observed_JWST (mean log10 ratio); ideal 1. No image flux fitting, PSF correction or noise subtraction.
settings.correlation: Mean over objects of real cross-spectrum / sqrt(P_model*P_observed_JWST), each annularly averaged first. Signed, phase-sensitive r; ideal 1. Not magnitude-squared coherence.
settings.rmse_intervals: Resample spatial blocks with replacement, retaining all objects and methods paired. Equal object weights within the resulting population. Percentile 95% intervals; conditional on this field, validation selection and trained checkpoints.
settings.spectral_intervals: 2000 paired spatial-block draws, seed 20261017. Objects have equal weight within each statistic; same block draws for all models.
